# updawg_enrollment_token (Resource)

A token agents enroll with (`enr_…`). The API has no way to change one, so changing any argument issues a new token and revokes the old; hosts already enrolled are unaffected. A token revoked in the portal is planned for re-issue.

⚠️ **The value is stored in Terraform state.** The API shows it once, at creation, and keeps only a hash, so state is the only place Terraform can keep it to hand to anything else. Treat state as a secret: an encrypted, access-controlled backend. Limiting `max_uses` and setting `expires_at` bounds what a leaked value is worth. Needs the token scope `enrollment`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "updawg_enrollment_token" "web" {
  name       = "web tier"
  labels     = { tier = "web" }
  max_uses   = 20
  expires_at = "2027-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}

# The value, for cloud-init or a configuration management secret.
output "web_enrollment_token" {
  value     = updawg_enrollment_token.web.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) What it is for — `web tier`, `laptop test`.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) When it stops working, as RFC 3339 (`2027-01-01T00:00:00Z`). Never, when left out. `timeadd(plantimestamp(), "720h")` would re-issue the token on every plan; use a fixed time or `time_rotating`.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels put on every host that enrolls with it.
- `max_uses` (Number) How many hosts it may enroll. Unlimited when left out. A use is counted at the host's first check-in, not at enrollment.
- `org` (String) The organization's slug. Defaults to the provider's `org`. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The token's record id, `etk_…`. Not the credential.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The value an agent enrolls with. Known only to the configuration that created it: an imported token has none.
- `usable` (Boolean) Whether an agent presenting it now would be let in: not revoked, expired or used up.
- `uses` (Number) Hosts that enrolled with it and then checked in.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The token's value cannot be imported: the API shows it once.
terraform import updawg_enrollment_token.web acme/etk_0193a4b2c1d0
```
